name: native-durable-input
description: Native-harness durable question, duplicate-safe continuation, fixed-inputs-across-pause, restart-semantics, and process-death-rule proof for M1.12 (issue #23). Depends on native-harness (file:../native-harness) and shared (file:../shared); reuses native-harness's createAgent/checkpointer/RoundRegistry and its additive AIMessage/tool/z/interrupt/Command re-exports so every LangChain/LangGraph object this package constructs comes from native-harness's own installed copies (avoids a dual-package instanceof hazard -- see the note in native-harness/src/index.ts).
